claim.quote: we performed tiling mutagenesis screens using Variant-EFFECTS at the PPIF locus in THP-1 cells (Fig. 2) and the promoter of IL2RA in stimulated Jurkat T cells (Data S1 section 1).

three edits disrupting the splice donor motif at the first 5' splice site of the PPIF gene in THP-1 monocytes ... effects from -80% to -52% for the single edits. All 3 edits strongly decreased PPIF expression.
